question: Lysozyme catalyzes the hydrolysis of:

options.opa: Proteins on the surface of bacteria and viruses.
options.opb: Proteins in the walls of Gram-negative bacteria.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Lysozyme -> catalyzes the hydrolysis of -> peptide bonds of bacterial peptidoglycans -> 95% CHAIN: Lysozyme -> targets -> bacterial cell walls -> containing peptidoglycans -> 90% CHAIN: Lysozyme -> acts on -> glycosidic links of bacterial polysaccharides -> 85% CHAIN: Lysozyme -> breaks down -> bacterial cell walls -> composed of peptidoglycans -> 95%
analysis: Lysozyme is an enzyme that catalyzes the hydrolysis of the glycosidic links in bacterial peptidoglycans, leading to bacterial cell lysis.
